text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: First, head to the gym—wait, no... Ugh, why do I keep forgetting?
choice_data_list: What are you doing over there?
What are you doing over there?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. I'm reviewing for tomorrow.
The rehearsal didn't go well at all...
Tomorrow is the day of the Halloween parade with outside guests. Her role was supposed to be guiding the children around to get candy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking about the kids watching me makes my heart race...
My lines and our route just completely fly out of my head...!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh...! J-Just one more time...!
I'll focus hard and memorize it properly this time...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Doto-chaaan!
We'll join in on your practice... okay?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Dotou-san.
Why are you wearing a pumpkin head...?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um, doing this somehow makes me feel
calm and lets me concentrate...
So I thought I'd review the route like this~...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I see...
Blocking your field of vision helps you calm down, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: !! That's it! If you wear the pumpkin for the actual parade too, wouldn't that keep you from getting nervous!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I see...?! But dressed like this, won't the kids be terrified of me...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Then let's revamp the parade's theme and immerse the children
in the world of Halloween!
We'll all play ghosts and spin a tale together!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now Doto won't have to be afraid of the costume!
Let us all take the stage together!

text_block_list.name: Top Road & Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good!
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... a-all for me...!
Uuu... thank you all so muuuuch~!!

On the day of the Halloween parade,
TM Opera O appeared before the gathered crowd of children!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, children of the night!
I am the Ghost King. Do you fancy some sweets?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: I love you sooo muuuuch!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful! Halloween is the absolute best time to seize some sweets!
My subordinates shall teach you how to gather them.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"I am a spirit of darkness. I bestow upon you a spell...
'Trick or Treat.'"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
These are... words that slip into the gaps of the heart.
Adults are trapped by darkness...
Before they know it, see... candy appears in their hands.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Did everyone manage to memorize it?
Whether you're feeling nervous or not,
you can practice with me—the Captain of the Ghost Squad!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's all become splendid ghosts together!
'Trick or Treat'!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: "Trick or treat"~~~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!! Magnificent!
Now then, from here on out, you shall heed the words of our final companion!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(It's my turn...! I-I'm okay.
I have my pumpkin... I can do this...!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
F-From here on out, I, the pumpkin
ghost, will be your guide~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-If you'd like, um...
I'd be happy if you just casually called me "Pumpkin Big Sis"...!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Look, it's the Pumpkin Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wah... e-ehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Past this point is a world overflowing with sweets~
Are you ready with your spell?
Well then, let's head to the school gates~...!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yeeees♪

Led by Meisho Doto,
the children gathered treats with great excitement!

Meisho Doto successfully finished the parade.
A look of pure satisfaction was written all over her face!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The pumpkin power blew all my nervousness away~
To think I could guide everyone without getting lost once... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I couldn't have done it alone.
You rushed to write the script, and stayed up late to practice with me..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...I was really happy that everyone helped out~.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Doto!
Let's raise a celebratory toast to our success!
Come join everyone at the gym party!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat~~!? O-Opera O-san and the others
went out of their way... to come for m-me... !?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat~~!? O-Opera O-san and the others
went out of their way... to come for m-me... !?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
Please waaaait――

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: *yaaaawn*~~!? Whoa-whoa-whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Doto-chan...! Look out!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Whew, glad I made it in time.
Take your time, there's no rush.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-You saved me again...!
Thank you so, so much... as always...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right!
Top Road-san stayed with me for rehearsals
right up until the very last minute, and—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "Cafe-san brewed coffee for me between practices, even though she must've been exhausted herself...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that, Opera O-san wrote a whole script just for me...!
Everyone is truly the best ever...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I-If you keep praising me like that...!
Wah, my face is getting so hot...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
……Geez, stop teasing me.
Yeah…… I'm happy. ……Fufu.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!
Your praise sounds as soothing as the strum of a harp!
Prithee, continue!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
I still have plenty more where that came from~~!
